name: bettersplats
description: Host-build dependencies for the BetterSplats engine, tools and tests on Windows. Linux CI takes these from apt (scripts/ci_linux.sh deps) and iOS from scripts/ios/build_deps.sh; this manifest exists so the same sources build with MSVC without a system package manager.

overrides.$comment: Linux CI builds against Ubuntu 24.04's libeigen3-dev, which is 3.4.0, and core/CMakeLists.txt asks for 3.4. The current vcpkg baseline ships Eigen 5.0.1 — a major version whose config file correctly refuses a 3.4 request. Pinning here rather than relaxing the find_package: the point of the Windows job is to prove the SAME sources against the SAME libraries, and a host quietly building on a different major version of the linear algebra library is exactly the kind of difference that shows up as a numerical discrepancy nobody can place.
overrides.name: eigen3

overrides.$comment: Pinned with eigen3 above, and for the same reason. ceres 2.2.0#6 asks for Eigen in the range 3.3...5, which under CMake's SameMajorVersion rules only Eigen 5.x can satisfy — the upper bound's major must match the version found, so a range ending at 5 rejects 3.4.0 despite containing it. Port-version 5 is the last that pairs with the Eigen the Linux job uses. Lifting both pins together is the upgrade path, once the engine has been built and TESTED against Eigen 5 rather than assumed compatible with it.
overrides.name: ceres
